name: Livermore
tagline: Trade planner that sizes positions and drafts Robinhood orders for your sign-off
description: Screens markets using the rule set you define, across styles from day trading to long holds. It proposes a position size for each idea and prepares an order for your linked Robinhood account, but nothing is submitted until you approve that exact order. It is a planning aid, not advice and not a return promise.
author: Screaming_Chkn
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
